title: Beyond Resemblance: Image Fusion Reimagined
summary: Image fusion often lacks ground-truth fused images, forcing existing deep methods to indirectly define fusion objectives by requiring the fused image to simultaneously resemble multiple source images. However, the distinct imaging characteristics of different modalities can impose competing constraints on the fused result, potentially limiting the effective integration of their complementary information. To address this long-standing challenge facing the image fusion community, we propose ApexFuse, a novel generative image fusion paradigm that moves beyond source-resemblance constraints toward learning a general distribution of high-quality scene representations. Specifically, we develop a human-LMM-in-the-loop pipeline that leverages large multimodal generative models and iterative human feedback to translate abstract fusion objectives into reliable visual references, thereby defining the target distribution of ideal fusion outcomes. Through target-distribution-guided adaptation, we transfer the rich generative priors of pretrained FLUX to image fusion, enabling high-quality scene reconstruction conditioned on multimodal observations. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ApexFuse harmoniously integrates salient thermal targets, natural colors, and fine textures, achieving superior visual quality as well as semantic segmentation and object detection performance over previous source-resemblance methods. Moreover, ApexFuse exhibits remarkable cross-task generalization, extending from infrared-visible fusion to multi-exposure fusion, multi-focus fusion, and visible-depth fusion without additional fine-tuning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ApexFuse，一种面向图像融合的生成式范式。它不再让融合结果同时模仿多个源图像，而是通过学习高质量场景表征的通用分布，解决不同模态成像特性带来的冲突约束问题。该方法的核⼼是⽤“⼈类—⼤语⾔/多模态模型⼈⼿环”⽣成可靠的理想融合参考，并将预训练⽣成模型FLUX的先验迁移到图像融合任务中，从⽽在可见光—红外、多曝光、多焦距、可见光—深度等多种任务上实现⾼质量融合和更强泛化。
AI.motivation: 图像融合同常缺少真实融合标签。现有深度⽅法往往通过“源图像约束”间接定义融合⽬标，即要求融合图像同时接近多个源图像。但不同模态具有不同的成像机制和视觉表征，例如红外⾮常强调热⽬标⽽颜色与纹理较弱，可⻅光强调⾃然⾊彩和细节，深度信息侧重⼏何/距离线索。这些约束可能相互冲突，限制源图像互补信息的有效整合。因此需要⼀种不再被“模仿源图”绑定的融合范式，转⽽直接学习理想场景表征的⽬标分布。
AI.method: 作者提出ApexFuse⽣成式图像融合框架，包含两个关键设计。其⼀，构建⼈类—⼤多模态模型协同闭环流程：利⽤⼤规模多模态⽣成模型和迭代⼈类反馈，将抽象、⼈⼯定义的融合⽬标转化为可⻓期使⽤、⾮常可靠的理想融合图像参考；这些参考从⽽定义理想融合结果的⽬标分布。其⼆，进⾏⽬标分布引导的适配：将预训练⽣成模型FLUX中丰富的⽣成先验迁移到图像融合场景，使模型能够在多模态观测条件下重构⾼质量、⼀致、语义正确的场景图像。通过该⽅法，融合结果不再被源图像之间的冲突约束⽀配，⽽是服从更⾼质量、更接近⼈类感知和任务需求的场景分布。
AI.result: ⼤量实验显示，ApexFuse能够和谐融合显著热⽬标、⾃然⾊彩和精细纹理，在视觉质量⽅⾯优于基于源图像相似性约束的传统⽅法。同时，它在下游语义分割和⽬标检测任务上取得更好性能。更重要的是，ApexFuse表现出强⼤的跨任务泛化能⼒：⽆需额外微调，即可从红外—可⻅光融合拓展到多曝光融合、多焦距融合和可⻅光—深度融合。
AI.conclusion: ApexFuse将图像融合从“要求融合图类似多个源图”的旧范式推进到“学习理想场景表征分布”的⽣成式范式。通过⼈类—⼤模型闭环构建可靠融合参考，再利⽤预训练⽣成模型先验进⾏目标分布引导适配，它解决了多模态成像约束冲突和⽆真实融合标签⻓期难题。结果表明，该⽅法在融合质量、语义保持、下游视觉任务性能以及跨任务零样本泛化⽅⾯均有显著优势。

title: Characterizing Age-Conditioned Affective Reasoning in Vision-Language Models
summary: An age prompt can change how a vision-language model (VLM) rates the emotion evoked by an image. Does the change predict how people of different ages rate that same image? We evaluate 17 VLMs on 900 OASIS images using young-, middle-, and older-adult prompts and estimate image-specific age differences from ratings by 822 participants. Without an age cue, models closely track average human valence (median Pearson $r=0.891$). Under an older-adult prompt, 16 of 17 models assign lower valence on average than under a young-adult prompt. Yet after adjusting for image pleasantness, correlations between model and human age effects range from $-0.030$ to $0.093$, against an estimated ceiling of $0.595$. The discrepancy is clearest on 54 sensitive images rated as pleasant. Across models, the older prompt reduces valence by $0.845$ points on average, while older participants rate these images $0.443$ points higher than younger participants. Providing human ratings from other images improves agreement on the direction of age differences, although image-specific fidelity remains modest on 600 held-out images ($r_{\mathrm{part}}=0.105$). These results show why evaluations of demographic personalization in foundation models need human comparisons at the level of individual stimuli. Project page available at this https URL

AI.tldr: 研究发现：视觉-语言模型对“年龄提示”的情绪评分变化不能可靠预测不同年龄人群对同一图片的情绪评价差异，提示基础模型的人口统计个性化评估需要在单个刺激图像层面与人类数据比较。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉-语言模型可通过提示语改变对图片情绪的评分，但这是否真正对应人类不同年龄群体的情绪差异尚不清楚。若仅使用平均人类评分或整体相关性，可能会高估模型的个性化能力，因此需要在个体刺激层面检验模型对年龄效应的刻画。
AI.method: 作者评估17个视觉-语言模型在900张OASIS图片上的情绪效价评分，分别使用年轻、中年和老年提示。同时利用822名参与者的评分估计每张特定图片上的年龄差异。分析中比较无年龄提示时模型与人类平均效价的匹配程度，并检验模型年龄提示造成的评分变化与人类真实年龄差异之间的相关性；进一步校正图片愉悦度，并分析54张对成人敏感但被评为愉悦的图片。还测试加入其他图片的人类评分是否能改善模型对年龄差异方向的预测。
AI.result: 无年龄提示时，模型平均评分与人类平均效价高度一致，中位Pearson相关系数为0.891。使用老年提示后，17个模型中有16个平均给出比年轻提示更低的效价。然而，在校正图片愉悦度后，模型年龄效应与人类年龄效应之间的相关系数仅为-0.030到0.093，显著低于估计上限0.595。差异在54张敏感但愉悦的图片上最明显：老年提示使模型平均降低0.845分效价，而老年参与者对这些图片的评分反而比年轻参与者高0.443分。加入其他图片的人类评分可改善方向一致性，但在600张保留图片上，逐图层面的忠实度仍较低，部分相关系数r_part=0.105。
AI.conclusion: 视觉-语言模型的年龄提示虽然能改变情绪评分，但其变化模式并不能充分代表人类不同年龄群体对具体图片的真实评价差异。评估基础模型的年龄或人口统计个性化时，不能只看整体平均相关性，而需要在单个刺激图像层面与人类数据进行细致比较。

title: AesDistill: Distilling Generative Aesthetics for Image Color Enhancement
summary: Image color enhancement aims to improve visual appeal, but previous methods often learn to reproduce ground-truth expert targets. These targets reflect the preferences of a few experts and cover a limited range of aesthetic choices. Matching them does not ensure stronger aesthetic quality across different tastes and scenes. By contrast, large generative models learn rich visual knowledge from large image collections and often produce vivid, appealing image edits. However, direct generation can change the source image's semantic structure along with its colors. In this paper, we introduce AesDistill, a framework for distilling generative aesthetics into image color enhancement. We use 4 leading open-source large generative models to produce 64,644 edited images as teacher targets at a cost of about 3,360 H100 GPU-hours, forming the AesDistill Dataset. AesDistill also includes AesDistill Student, a 1.13M-parameter model that learns teacher color changes through confidence-weighted supervision while preserving the source image's semantic structure. We evaluate AesDistill with 12 aesthetic and 4 image-quality assessment models. Every teacher's targets rank above the FiveK and PPR10K expert target means in the joint assessment. Across both datasets, AesDistill Student outperforms all 20 baseline methods and ranks directly behind the 4 teachers. These results demonstrate that distilling aesthetics from generative models enables a compact student to outperform methods trained on expert targets.

AI.tldr: 论文提出AesDistill框架，将大生成模型的审美编辑能力蒸馏到轻量图像色彩增强模型中，以突破专家标注目标范围有限、生成模型可能改变图像语义结构的问题。
AI.motivation: 传统图像色彩增强方法通常学习复现专家修图目标，但这些目标只能反映少数专家偏好，覆盖的审美选择有限，难以适应不同审美风格和拍摄场景。另一方面，大型生成模型能够从海量图像数据中学习丰富视觉知识，常常生成鲜艳美观的编辑结果，但直接用于图像编辑时可能同时改变源图像的语义结构。因此，需要一种方法既能吸收生成模型中的审美知识，又能在增强色彩的同时保持源图像内容结构。
AI.method: 作者提出AesDistill框架，利用4个领先开源大生成模型生成64,644张编辑图像作为教师目标，构建AesDistill数据集，总计算成本约3,360个H100 GPU小时。框架还包括一个1.13M参数的轻量学生模型AesDistill Student，该模型通过置信度加权监督学习教师模型产生的颜色变化，同时保持源图像的语义结构。
AI.result: 实验采用12个美学评估模型和4个图像质量评估模型进行评测。结果显示，每个教师模型的编辑目标在综合评估中的得分均高于FiveK和PPR10K专家目标平均值。在两个数据集上，AesDistill Student超过全部20个基线方法，仅次于4个教师模型，表明蒸馏生成模型审美知识能够使轻量模型取得优于专家目标监督方法的性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过从大生成模型中蒸馏审美知识进行图像色彩增强，可以在保持源图像语义结构的同时获得更强审美质量，并使仅1.13M参数的学生模型超越基于专家目标训练的方法和大量基线方法。

title: Interpreting DeepStack-Style Vision-Language Models: Do Input or Deeper-Layer Visual Tokens Drive Answers?
summary: DeepStack-style vision-language models feed visual tokens to the language model at its input, and again at deeper layers. We call these the main entry and the later entries. What do the later entries add when the model already has the image? We give the entries versions that differ in one object's color and see which one the answer follows. On photographs, the original DeepStack follows the later entries, while Qwen3-VL-8B/32B follow the main entry. Does weakening the main entry give the later features more influence? On synthetic images, we keep this conflict and reduce color saturation at the main entry only. The unchanged later features gain a stronger effect on the relative scores of the two colors, in all four models, including Granite Vision. This holds even under mild desaturation, when accuracy without the conflict stays at 100%. To test whether later features can also correct errors, we degrade both entries and restore only the later ones. The same blur costs both Qwen models 50 percentage points of accuracy on stripe orientation. The 32B model recovers 48 points and the 8B model only 8. Accuracy with one clean entry predicted which entry each model can lose, and five of six tested predictions held on new GQA attribute questions. With the other entry zeroed, Qwen3-VL-8B loses only 0.3 points on its main entry alone, and DeepStack at most 3.45 points on either entry alone. In split inference on these questions, DeepStack can then send only its main-entry features at higher precision. This takes 49% fewer bytes than all entries at a shared precision, at similar accuracy.
comment: Includes the supplementary material. Code and numerical results: this https URL

AI.tldr: 该研究分析DeepStack式视觉-语言模型中“主入口”视觉输入与“后续深层入口”视觉输入各自的作用，发现后续输入并非简单冗余：它们可影响模型判断、在弱主输入下增强作用，并在一定条件下帮助纠错，但效果依赖具体模型；进一步利用这一特性可在拆分推理中只传输高精度主入口特征，显著降低通信量。
AI.motivation: DeepStack式模型会在语言模型输入层以及更深层多次注入视觉token。已有问题是：如果主入口已经包含图像信息，后续入口还提供什么额外价值？理解这一点有助于判断视觉信息在模型不同层中的分配方式、鲁棒性来源、可解释性以及分布式/端侧推理中的传输策略。
AI.method: 作者构造两个入口在同一物体颜色上互相冲突的输入版本，观察模型答案跟随主入口还是后续入口。随后仅在图像合成数据中降低主入口的颜色饱和度，而保持后续入口特征不变，测试后续特征对两种颜色相对得分的影响是否增强。再通过同时退化两个入口、仅恢复后续入口来检验后续特征能否纠错。实验比较原始DeepStack、Qwen3-VL-8B、Qwen3-VL-32B和Granite Vision等模型，并在GQA属性问答上验证基于单入口准确率的预测。最后研究拆分推理场景下只发送主入口高精度特征的通信压缩效果。
AI.result: 在真实照片的颜色冲突实验中，原始DeepStack更跟随后续入口，而Qwen3-VL-8B和Qwen3-VL-32B更跟随主入口。当仅削弱主入口颜色饱和度时，未改变的后续特征在四个模型中都增强了对颜色相对得分的影响，甚至在无冲突情况下准确率仍为100%的轻度去饱和条件下也成立。在模糊导致两个入口同时退化的条纹方向任务中，两个Qwen模型均下降约50个百分点；但32B模型在只恢复后续入口时回升48个百分点，8B模型仅回升8个百分点。单入口干净输入下的准确率能够较好预测模型可丢失哪个入口，六项预测中五项在新的GQA属性问题上成立。另一入口被置零时，Qwen3-VL-8B仅凭主入口只损失0.3分，而DeepStack仅凭任一入口最多损失3.45分。在拆分推理中，DeepStack可只以较高精度传输主入口特征，相比以共享精度传输所有入口减少49%的传输字节，同时保持相近准确率。
AI.conclusion: 后续深层视觉入口不是冗余通道，而是可以在颜色判断、鲁棒性和错误恢复中发挥作用；但其贡献强度存在明显模型差异。主入口与后续入口之间的信息权重可通过单入口评测部分预测，并可用于优化多设备或端侧VLM推理：在某些模型和问题上，优先传输高保真主入口特征即可显著降低通信开销。

title: What Places an Action Boundary? Structure-Aware Attribution for Temporal Action Localization
summary: Temporal action localization (TAL) detectors must identify actions and estimate their temporal boundaries, but localization remains a major source of detection errors. While understanding what determines boundary placement requires faithful attribution of temporal evidence, existing attribution methods have not sufficiently addressed the temporal structure of TAL or the need to tailor attribution to boundary localization. We introduce a structure-aware attribution framework that averages contributions across random evidence-restoration orders following the Shapley-Shubik principle. We make it tractable by using the detector's receptive field to limit which time steps are ordered individually, and by approximating each order with a soft gradient path. For boundary predictions, we further introduce cell-structured restoration orders and boundary-anchored references that selectively remove adjacent evidence. We also adapt faithfulness evaluation to assess the joint effects of contiguous temporal evidence and the direction of boundary displacement. Experiments on THUMOS14 and EPIC-KITCHENS-100 with TriDet and ActionFormer demonstrate improved attribution faithfulness over existing methods. Attribution analysis and controlled interventions further reveal that class-score changes do not reliably track boundary displacement, providing input-level evidence that classification relies on content less informative about boundary placement. Code and evaluation artifacts will be publicly released.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种面向时序动作定位（TAL）的结构感知归因框架，通过 Shapley-Shubik 式证据恢复顺序平均、感受野约束和软梯度路径近似，并结合边界导向的单元格式恢复顺序与边界锚定参照，提升时间边界预测的归因忠实度；实验表明其在 THUMOS14 和 EPIC-KITCHENS-100 上优于现有方法，并揭示分类分数变化不能可靠反映边界位移。
AI.motivation: 时序动作定位中的主要检测误差来自边界定位不准，而理解边界如何形成需要可靠地归因到输入时间步的证据。现有归因方法往往面向整体分类预测，未充分考虑 TAL 的时间序列结构，也未针对边界定位任务设计适合的证据移除、贡献分配与忠实度评估方式。
AI.method: 作者提出结构感知归因框架：1）遵循 Shapley-Shubik 原理，对随机证据恢复顺序上的贡献进行平均，以刻画时间步的真实影响；2）利用检测器感受野限制需要单独排序的时间步，降低组合复杂度；3）使用软梯度路径近似每条恢复顺序，使归因过程可计算；4）针对边界预测引入单元格结构的恢复顺序和边界锚定参照，选择性移除边界附近的相邻证据，从而分析边界位移；5）改造忠实度评估，考察连续时间证据的联合影响以及边界移动方向。
AI.result: 在 THUMOS14 和 EPIC-KITCHENS-100 数据集上，以 TriDet 和 ActionFormer 为检测器进行实验，所提方法在归因忠实度上优于已有归因方法。归因分析和受控干预进一步表明，类别得分的变化与边界位移并不稳定对应，说明模型分类所依赖的内容与边界定位所需的时间信息存在不一致性。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为 TAL 边界定位提供了更忠实、更符合时序结构的归因工具，并揭示分类证据与边界证据并非高度一致。其对理解 TAL 检测器失败模式、改进边界建模以及设计更可靠的视频理解可解释方法具有意义。

title: Why Flat Drafts Stay Flat: Region-Mean Latents Govern Texture in Flow-Based Image Generation
summary: Flat color-block drafts specify layout and regional color while leaving interior detail unspecified, yet pretrained flow-based generators can preserve their flat appearance even under photorealistic prompts. We trace this behavior to a cross-scale mechanism linking fine pixel variation to regional means in variational autoencoder (VAE) latent space. Flattening photo regions systematically shifts their latent means, with offsets concentrated along a shared channel direction within each backbone. Controlled field exchanges in FLUX.1-dev and Qwen-Image establish the effect of this displacement on texture generation: adding the photo-derived regional mean field to a flat latent restores texture, whereas adding its complementary field alone largely preserves flatness. A second-order encoding expansion explains how encoder curvature can convert zero-mean perturbations into mean shifts. An analytically solvable conditional Gaussian flow shows how regional noise averaging enables near-unit endpoint sensitivity at high signal-to-noise ratios. This mechanism motivates training-free rendering through pixel dither before encoding, mean-field scaling, and early boundary holding. Paired low-rank adaptation (LoRA) with draft conditioning improves content recovery and produces photo-like regional means under the standard velocity objective. Explicit regional mean guidance remains effective after adaptation, continuously controlling texture and improving color fidelity. These findings connect encoding shifts to persistent generation behavior and support interventions evaluated for texture, spatial fidelity, and semantic recovery.

AI.tldr: 该研究揭示平面色块草稿导致预训练流式生成器生成扁平图像的根本原因：VAE潜空间中区域均值发生沿共享通道方向的偏移，并提出训练无关干预与LoRA、显式均值引导来恢复纹理、空间保真和语义。
AI.motivation: 平面色块草稿只规定布局和大区域颜色，不指定内部细节，但预训练流式生成器即使在真实感提示下仍倾向于保留扁平外观。作者希望解释这种跨尺度生成偏差的机制，并找到能恢复纹理和内容真实感的方法。
AI.method: 作者从VAE潜空间中细粒度像素变化与区域均值之间的跨尺度关系入手，分析将照片区域展平后潜变量均值的系统偏移，并发现偏移集中于各骨干网络内部的共享通道方向。通过在FLUX.1-dev和Qwen-Image中进行受控场交换实验，比较加入照片派生的区域均值场与其互补场对纹理生成的影响；进一步用二阶编码展开解释编码器曲率如何把零均值扰动转换为均值偏移，并用可解析的条件高斯流说明区域噪声平均如何在高信噪比下产生接近单位敏感度的端点效应。最后提出像素抖动编码、均值场缩放和早期边界保持等训练无关渲染策略，并结合带草稿条件的LoRA微调与显式区域均值引导。
AI.result: 实验表明，扁平化照片区域会系统性地改变潜变量均值，而补充照片派生区域均值场可恢复纹理，仅加入互补场则大多保持扁平。理论分析支持编码偏移导致持续生成行为的机制。训练无关方法能在一定程度上改善渲染；LoRA在标准速度目标下提升内容恢复并产生更接近照片的区域均值；显式区域均值引导在微调后仍有效，可连续控制纹理并提升颜色保真度。
AI.conclusion: 论文发现并解释了平面草稿导致流式生成器输出扁平图像的关键机制：VAE编码中的区域均值偏移与跨尺度噪声平均效应。该机制不仅说明了问题来源，也为训练无关干预、LoRA微调和显式区域均值引导提供了依据，从而改善纹理、空间保真和语义恢复。

title: TwinD: Generalizing Deepfake Detection from Blending to Entire Face Synthesis
summary: Facial deepfake detectors are usually trained on blending fakes, where a generated face is pasted back into a real frame. Recent generators synthesize the entire face and leave no traces of blending. On a benchmark of 19 datasets released from 2019 to 2026, the best prior facial deepfake detector reaches a mean AUROC of 96.2% on ten blending datasets, but none exceeds 78.1% on five datasets of entire face synthesis (EFS). AI-generated content (AIGC) detectors do not close this gap. We propose TwinD, a detector trained on FaceForensics++ fakes and two kinds of twins: fakes made from a real frame. A reconstruction twin is a real frame reconstructed by an autoencoder, with the real pixels put back in a random region. It targets the neural traces of a decoder. A blob twin blends an altered copy of a real frame with the frame itself, targeting blending artifacts. It needs no generator and no face-shaped mask. Together, these twins provide two complementary forensic cues that generalize to unseen manipulations. TwinDreaches a mean AUROC of 96.3%, 8.9 points above the prior state-of-the-art, with 98.1% on the blending datasets and 95.6% on the EFS datasets. Trained on twins alone, without a deepfake dataset, single models still reach 94.3% on average over three seeds. For reproducibility, the code, trained model, and training data are at: this https URL

AI.tldr: 论文提出 TwinD 面部深度伪造检测器，通过构造两类“孪生样本”——重建孪生与 blob 融合孪生——同时学习解码器痕迹与融合伪影，显著提升在整脸合成（EFS）等未见伪造类型上的检测能力。
AI.motivation: 现有面部深度伪造检测器多基于“局部融合”伪造训练，即把生成人脸贴回真实帧；但新型生成器可合成整张脸，不再留下融合痕迹。论文指出的问题是：在 19 个 2019 至 2026 数据集的基准上，既有最佳检测器在 10 个融合式伪造数据集上平均 AUROC 为 96.2%，但在 5 个整脸合成数据集上不超过 78.1%；一般 AIGC 检测器也无法弥补这一泛化差距。
AI.method:
TwinD 使用 FaceForensics++ 的伪造样本以及两类无需真实生成器即可构造的训练“孪生”样本：

1. **重建孪生（Reconstruction Twin）**：用自编码器重建真实帧，并在随机区域回填真实像素。其作用是让检测器学习自编码器/生成器解码器留下的神经网络痕迹。

2. **Blob 孪生（Blob Twin）**：将真实帧的一个 altered copy 与原帧本身融合，形成类似伪造混合边界/痕迹的样本，不需要生成器，也不需要人脸形状掩码。其作用是让检测器学习融合伪影和边界不一致性。

两类孪生提供互补取证线索：一方面针对现代生成器可能留下的内部解码器痕迹，另一方面针对传统融合式伪造痕迹，从而提升对未见操控的泛化能力。
AI.result: 在 19 个数据集的跨域评测中，TwinD 达到 **96.3% 的平均 AUROC**，较之前最先进水平提升 **8.9 个百分点**。其中在融合式伪造数据集上达到 **98.1% AUROC**，在整脸合成（EFS）数据集上达到 **95.6% AUROC**。即使只使用孪生样本训练、不使用深度伪造数据集，单个模型在三个随机种子上的平均性能仍可达 **94.3% AUROC**。论文还提供代码、训练模型和训练数据以提高可复现性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作的核心结论是：面向“无融合痕迹的整脸生成伪造”，不能只依赖真实生成器合成的大量 fake 数据，而应通过低成本构造的孪生样本提取两类互补伪迹线索。TwinD 表明，自编码器重建痕迹与融合伪影的联合训练能够显著改善面部深度伪造检测器在未见数据集和新型生成范式上的泛化性能。

title: Sample-efficient end-to-end Optical Music Recognition through Active Learning
summary: End-to-end approaches to Optical Music Recognition (OMR) have recently shown promising results, but their performance often degrades on unseen data. A common solution is to pretrain and fine-tune models with annotated samples from the target domain, improving adaptation to new distributions. However, this process typically requires extensive manual annotation to yield competitive models, making it costly and time-consuming. In this work, we explore Active Learning to reduce this burden by selecting informative samples for labeling in low-resource scenarios, where the amount of manual annotation that can be performed is limited. We evaluate both uncertainty- and diversity-based sampling strategies on staff-level and full-page corpora. Results show that confidence-based sampling performs comparably to oracle selection (based on true error), and that each scenario benefits from a tailored strategy.

AI.tldr: 该研究将主动学习引入端到端光学音乐识别（OMR）的预训练—微调流程，通过选择信息量较大的样本进行标注，在低资源条件下降低人工标注成本，并比较不确定性与多样性采样策略在谱表级和整页语料上的效果。
AI.motivation: 端到端OMR模型在未见过数据上性能下降，需要目标域标注样本进行适配；但完整人工标注成本高、耗时长，尤其在可标注样本有限的低资源场景中更为突出。因此需要一种样本选择方法，用少量标注提升模型适应能力。
AI.method: 作者采用主动学习策略，从候选数据中挑选最有价值样本进行人工标注并用于训练。评估了两类采样策略：不确定性采样（包括基于置信度的策略）和多样性采样。实验在谱表级语料和整页语料上进行，并与基于真实错误率的oracle选择进行比较。
AI.result: 置信度驱动的不确定性采样能够达到与oracle选择相近的性能，说明模型自身置信度可作为有效的样本难度指标。同时，不同场景（谱表级与整页级）更适合不同的主动学习策略。
AI.conclusion: 主动学习能在低资源OMR适配中减少标注负担。基于置信度的不确定性采样是实用且有效的选择策略，但策略应根据数据粒度和任务场景进行定制，而不是采用单一固定方案。

title: Learning to Think with Images Faithfully via Adaptive Data Selection
summary: Thinking with images (TwI) empowers vision-language models (VLMs) to overcome perceptual bottlenecks by actively cropping and zooming into fine-grained visual details, promising both higher accuracy and interpretable, region-grounded reasoning. However, our analysis shows that the improved accuracy of TwI models does not guarantee faithful tool use; they frequently invoke tools without actually relying on the zoomed region, undermining the reliability of tool-assisted reasoning. We trace this unfaithful behaviour to the training data: when questions are answerable without zooming, the model can answer correctly while ignoring the returned evidence, and this problem is exacerbated during training as the model becomes better at answering without tools. To keep zooming useful throughout training, we adapt the training data to the model's evolving capability and train on questions where correct zoomed evidence can still help the model answer correctly. This selection is supported by a data synthesis pipeline that localises small objects and constructs verifiable questions about their fine details, and complemented by an adaptiveness reward that favours tool-free answers when zooming is unnecessary. The experimental results show that our method substantially improves reasoning faithfulness and achieves state-of-the-art performance on visual search benchmarks (+11.6% on V*, +7.9% on HR-Bench 4K, and +9.4% on HR-Bench 8K). On multimodal hallucination benchmarks, our model also outperforms the compared TwI baselines. These results suggest that improving TwI faithfulness does not sacrifice accuracy and that both can be learnt from the right training data without directly supervising the reasoning process.

AI.tldr: 该工作发现“带图思考”（Thinking with Images, TwI）虽然能提升视觉语言模型的细粒度视觉问答准确率，但并不保证模型忠实地使用工具获得的放大区域证据；通过随模型能力变化筛选“放大证据仍有贡献”的训练问题、结合小目标定位与可验证问题合成，以及引入“适应性奖励”，在显著提升推理忠实度的同时取得视觉搜索和幻觉基准上的更优性能。
AI.motivation: TwI 模型通过主动裁剪和放大图像局部来增强视觉语言模型对细粒度信息的感知，被认为既可能提高准确率，也能提供可解释、区域接地的推理。但本文发现，更高的准确率并不等价于工具使用的忠实性：模型经常虽然调用了裁剪/放大工具，却并未依赖返回的放大区域，仍基于原始图像或先验知识作答。作者进一步分析认为，问题出在训练数据：如果问题不需要放大也能答对，模型就会学会忽略工具返回的证据，而且随着模型能力增强，这种不忠实倾向会被放大。因此，需要在不损害准确率的前提下，让工具调用真正与正确推理相关联，并构建能促使模型有效利用放大证据的训练数据。
AI.method: 提出以训练数据自适应选择为核心的方法：根据模型在训练过程中的能力变化，筛选那些“只有利用正确放大证据仍有帮助”的问题进行训练，避免让模型学习大量无需放大即可作答的问题。为支持该选择，作者构建了数据合成流程：先定位图像中的小目标，再围绕目标的细粒度视觉属性构造可验证的问题，使工具放大区域与答案具有更强的相关性。同时引入适应性奖励机制，在确实不需要工具时鼓励模型直接作答，在需要局部视觉证据时促使模型利用工具输出，从而抑制无意义或形式化的工具调用。
AI.result: 实验表明，该方法显著提升 TwI 模型的推理忠实性，并在多个视觉搜索基准上取得最先进性能：V* 提升 11.6%，HR-Bench 4K 提升 7.9%，HR-Bench 8K 提升 9.4%。在多模态幻觉基准上，该方法也优于对比的 TwI 基线，说明更忠实、更依赖有效视觉证据的工具使用方式能够减少幻觉并提升整体推理质量。
AI.conclusion: TwI 的准确性提升与工具使用忠实性并不必然一致；若训练数据允许模型忽略工具证据，模型容易形成“调用但不使用”的不忠实推理模式。通过让训练数据随模型能力动态匹配、构造依赖局部证据的可验证问题，并设计适应性奖励，可以同时提高 TwI 的忠实性和准确率，而无需对推理过程进行直接监督。

title: Coda-DaVinci: Reimagining Video Generation with Code2Video
summary: Code2Video uses agent-authored 3D proxies to guide video generation, enabling explicit control over structure and dynamics. However, how to construct proxies and prompts for optimal downstream quality remains underexplored, as do the capabilities and limitations of this paradigm. Through controlled experiments and blinded human evaluation, we study proxy granularity, physics simulation, and prompting. The results reveal task-dependent trade-offs: coarse proxies favor natural motion, while medium-grained proxies favor consistency. Physics simulation and proxy-aligned prompting further improve average quality. Guided by these findings, we introduce Coda-DaVinci, a task-adaptive agentic framework for Code2Video generation that selects between proxy-guided and direct generation, adapts modeling granularity to each entity, and coordinates simulation with proxy-grounded prompting. Its multi-agent harness preserves scene assets and guides repairs through visual inspection and independent review. Experiments demonstrate leading instruction following on VTR and scene consistency on R2M, improved physical plausibility over direct generation, and higher visual realism than the compared Code2Video baselines. Long-video evaluations further show gains in event structure and consistency across successive interactions, while revealing limitations in transition stability and adherence to scene settings.

AI.tldr: Code2Video使用智能体生成的3D代理来引导视频生成，但代理构建和提示设计的最优策略尚不明确；本文通过受控实验和盲测评估研究代理粒度、物理仿真与提示方式，并提出任务自适应的智能体框架Coda-DaVinci，以提升指令跟随、场景一致性和物理合理性。
AI.motivation: 现有Code2Video范式通过3D代理显式控制视频结构与动态，但如何构造代理、如何设计提示以优化下游视频质量仍然缺乏系统研究。同时，该范式的能力边界和局限，例如不同任务对代理粒度的偏好、物理仿真是否有益、提示与代理对齐的重要性等，也尚未被充分探索。
AI.method: 作者首先通过受控实验和盲法人工评估，系统比较代理粒度、物理仿真以及提示策略对生成质量的影响。基于实验发现，进一步提出Coda-DaVinci任务自适应智能体框架：根据任务选择代理引导生成或直接生成；针对不同实体动态适配建模粒度；协调物理仿真与基于代理的提示。其多智能体流程还通过视觉检查和独立评审来保留场景资产并指导问题修复。
AI.result: 实验结果显示，任务之间存在明显的权衡：粗粒度代理更有利于自然运动，中等粒度代理更有利于一致性；引入物理仿真以及与代理对齐的提示可进一步提升平均质量。Coda-DaVinci在VTR上表现出领先的指令跟随能力，在R2M上展现出更强的场景一致性，相比直接生成具有更高的物理合理性，相比对比的Code2Video基线具有更高的视觉真实感。长视频评估进一步表明其在事件结构和连续交互一致性上有所提升，但也暴露出转场稳定性和场景设定遵循方面的不足。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，Code2Video中代理引导生成具有价值，但代理粒度、物理仿真和提示设计需要根据任务特性自适应选择。Coda-DaVinci通过任务自适应和多智能体协调提升了生成质量与可控性，验证了该范式在复杂视频生成中的潜力。同时，长视频中的转场稳定性和场景设定遵循仍是未来需要进一步解决的问题。
